subject: [PATCH v3] mm: remove min_free_kbytes adjustment for THP

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the impact of removing min_free_kbytes adjustment on THP, specifically questioning why the page allocator is doing anything wrong and suggesting that a large bucket size may not be suitable.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Responded to Johannes' concerns, clarifying that the page allocator is doing nothing wrong and explaining why a large bucket size may not be suitable for THP.

2026-09-04.patch_summary: The patch proposes removing the min_free_kbytes adjustment for Transparent Huge Pages (THP).
